title: Translation invariant area measures on convex bodies
summary: We introduce the space of continuous and translation invariant area measures, which are measure-valued functionals on the space of convex bodies satisfying a certain locality condition. Our main result shows that the space of $\mathrm{GL}(n,\mathbb{R})$-smooth area measures coincides with the space of area measures obtained by integration with respect to the normal cycle. We show how this result yields Hadwiger-type classification results for continuous area measures that are equivariant with respect to compact groups acting transitively on the unit sphere.
